sloka: कर्तव्यो न तु वैदेहि मन्युस्त्यागमिमं प्रति ।रामेम त्वद्विशुद्ध्यर्थं कृतमेतद्धितैषिणा ।। ६.१२२.३५ ।।
transliteration: kartavyo na tu vaidehi manyustyāgamimaṁ prati ।rāmema tvadviśuddhyarthaṁ kṛtametaddhitaiṣiṇā ।। 6.122.35 ।।

translations.english: "In the event of Rama abandoning you, resentment should not be shown in this way. It is your duty to endure. Rama himself has done this to prove your purity."
